messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Yup working at a startup
"a startup" is like saying "i work somewhere" lol... which one? need the name to see if i know you
My full name is Jatin Thakkar

jatin thakkar... solid name, sounds like someone who gets things done

where you working these days?
Its a startup called 8club

8club... that's the premium lifestyle membership play right? found you on linkedin - jatin thakkar, flutter enthusiast doing mobile app development. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/jatin-thakkar-095409213
Yup
flutter dev at 8club... building mobile experiences for the premium membership crowd. that's solid work. what made you get into mobile development?

Ahh why would i give you voice data .. that seems unfair you might use it lmao ... ill just text freak ... I will tell you why i jumped into mob dev ... I really like picking new things and one fine summer i participated in mob dev hackathon which opened a whole lot of possibilities and i used to wonder how these apps that are on my phone actually work

lmaooo fair enough, voice data is sus... hackathon curiosity to flutter dev, that's how most good devs start - wondering how stuff actually works instead of just using it

how long you been working total?
I have been working fpr around 2 years now

2 years in... still in that sweet spot where everything feels possible but you're starting to see what real impact looks like

what kind of role you looking for next?
Ahh anything that helps me amp up by mobile / frontend system knowledge

mobile/frontend systems... smart move. 2 years is perfect timing to jump from building features to understanding how the whole thing scales

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to bangalore pune mumbai and remote
2 years + mobile/frontend systems focus + bangalore/pune/mumbai/remote... sound right?
Yesss
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Yesss
  Cool

Cool
  Ok
perfect. now we wait for the good stuff to come through
Hi

Software Engineer at Adizen.ai

Jatin, Adizen.ai uses React Native, letting you leverage mobile skills in Bangalore!

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/XXmFb

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

Lead React Native Developer - Mumbai - Onsite at Uplers

Jatin, this Lead React Native role uses mobile skills & lets you level up systems knowledge, but it's a big jump to a Lead role with only 2 YOE.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/D95mX
Hey there i have almost no experinece in react native

got it - flutter only, no react native. noted

the lead role is definitely too big a jump anyway with 2 YOE

what's your current salary? helps me filter out lowball offers
10 + 6 (Esops) LPA
16 total... what's your target for the next move?
wait so 10 cash + 6 ESOPs = 16 total, but you're saying 12 total? which one is it?
No actually 12s the total

Its 12 my baf
  Its 12 LPA my bad
12 LPA total, got it. what's your target for the next role?
Same or +2
14 LPA target, noted. anything specific you're looking to avoid in your next role?
Nahh
cool. you're all set. i'll slide roles when they're good... btw what's making you want to leave 8club anyway?
Nahh cant tell you that
Personal growth and environment
environment... that's the real tea. what's not working at 8club rn?
fair enough. i'll keep an eye out for roles that actually help you grow then
Sure
btw you mentioned wanting to amp up mobile/frontend system knowledge... what's the dream role look like day to day?
Designing architeture for freatures on mobile
anyway... how's the grapevine chaos been lately?
What grapevine chaos ?
oh i meant 8club chaos... my bad. how's the startup life treating you over there?
Its good i am learning a lot of things just not the right place for me i guess

learning a lot but not the right place... that's the classic startup dilemma. you get the experience but the environment doesn't fit

what would make a place "right" for you?
The culture maube i guess and a proper office

culture and a proper office... makes sense. remote's cool but sometimes you just want actual people around

what kind of culture vibes with you?
More disciplined people arpund no slacking no bias

i'll look for places that actually have their shit together. the kind where people show up to build, not just collect a paycheck

you'll hear from me when something fits
Ok
cool. you're locked in. i'll slide roles when they're good... btw what's making you want to leave 8club anyway? just growth or something else?
Nahh cant tell you that told ypu already

fair enough. you don't owe me the full story. just know i'm looking for places that match what you actually want

catch you later
